mapper.insert: INSERT INTO follows ( follower_user_id, following_user_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{followerUserId}, #{followingUserId}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND delete_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM follows f JOIN users u ON u.user_id = f.follower_user_id AND u.delete_at IS NULL WHERE f.following_user_id = #{userId}

SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.name, u.profile_img, u.account_vis, f.created_at AS followed_at, CASE WHEN u.user_id = #{viewerUserId} THEN 'SELF' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM follows vf WHERE vf.follower_user_id = #{viewerUserId} AND vf.following_user_id = u.user_id ) THEN 'FOLLOWING' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM follow_requests fr WHERE fr.requester_user_id = #{viewerUserId} AND fr.receiver_user_id = u.user_id AND fr.status = 'PENDING' ) THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'NOT_FOLLOWING' END AS viewer_relation FROM follows f JOIN users u ON u.user_id = f.follower_user_id AND u.delete_at IS NULL WHERE f.following_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
